notes.title: The Filmmaker Update
notes.content:
Hey everyone,

It's been some time, but [i]The Filmmaker[/i] has received a new update.  The changes are both cosmetic, featuring a new graphic style that fits the look of our latest game, [i]Stonewall Penitentiary[/i], and functional, consisting of engine optimization and bug fixes.  A full list of changes is below.

Changes in the latest update:

- Updated graphics to fit new graphic novel style of [i]Stonewall Penitentiary[/i]
- Added text resizing options on the PC, along with scrolling
- Improved inventory handling
- Added compass direction labels on the PC
- Optimized engine
- Small gameplay-related bug fixes and grammatical errors

In addition, we've created a new Steam group!  Join the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/groups/storycentric]Storycentric Worlds[/url] community today to stay up-to-date on our latest projects.

Regards,
The Unimatrix Productions Team
